name: Shrewd Negotiations
summary: Magus Wordeen Voidglare praises your infiltration of the mages' city, and says the time has come to be more negotiatory. You are to carry the arcane mote you acquired to Archmage Celindra in Dalaran.

sections.title: Time to Negotiate
sections.body: Magus Wordeen Voidglare admits that no place on Azeroth rivals the Kirin Tor for knowledge of the arcane, and that even Wordeen's own brilliant work pales beside their ancient wisdom. He thinks it high time the Horde was granted access to their exclusive order. You are to carry the mote you acquired to Archmage Celindra in Dalaran, for Wordeen is sure the Kirin Tor will give anything to get it back.

faq.q: Who sends you to negotiate with Dalaran?
faq.answer: Magus Wordeen Voidglare, who wants to be more negotiatory after your infiltration of the city.

faq.q: Who are you sent to speak with?

faq.answer: The arcane mote you acquired. Wordeen is sure the Kirin Tor will give anything to have it back.

faq.q: Why does Wordeen Voidglare want to deal with Dalaran?
faq.answer: Wordeen admits no place on Azeroth rivals the Kirin Tor for knowledge of the arcane, and thinks it is time the Horde was granted access to their exclusive order.
